title: House on Haunted Hill
description: The owner of a haunted mansion offers a group of people reward money if they can survive a night at his scary estate.

title: Blind Horizon
description: An injured man (Val Kilmer) who cannot remember the past thinks he is involved in a plot to assassinate the president.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: Piranha
description: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

title: Serving Sara
description: A woman (Elizabeth Hurley) tries to persuade a process server (Matthew Perry) to help her turn the tables on her conniving husband (Bruce Campbell).

title: Hopscotch
description: An ex-CIA agent (Walter Matthau) and his lover (Glenda Jackson) write a book about the agency, one jump ahead of agents sent to stop them.

title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
description: Filmmaker Ed Wood Jr.'s laughable tale of alien invaders and resurrected corpses in the San Fernando Valley.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: Red Riding: 1974
description: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a missing-child case that mirrors that of a series of child abductions and murders that took place in previous years.

title: A Better Tomorrow II
description: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

title: Filly Brown
description: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

title: C.H.U.D.
description: Lovers (John Heard, Kim Greist) and other New Yorkers face cannibalistic humanoid underground dwellers, spawned by toxic waste.

title: Red Headed Stranger
description: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie; however, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

title: Silver City
description: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

title: Going All the Way
description: An outgoing Korean War veteran (Ben Affleck) befriends an introspective comrade (Jeremy Davies) in their Indianapolis hometown.

title: Succubus
description: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

title: Eraserhead
description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

title: Dead Ringers
description: Twin-brother gynecologists (Jeremy Irons) are divided by a patient (Geneviève Bujold) and doomed by drugs.

title: I'm Charlie Walker
description: Trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker fights institutional racism while cleaning up a massive oil spill off the coast of San Francisco in 1971.

title: Nosferatu
description: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

title: The Boys From Brazil
description: An old Nazi-hunter (Laurence Olivier) finds Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) and a cohort (James Mason) in the jungle, cloning Hitler for the Fourth Reich.

title: Showdown at the Grand
description: A movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

title: Suburbia
description: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: Rough Magic
description: A sleazy politician sends an agent (Russell Crowe) after his ex-fiancee (Bridget Fonda), who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.

title: Slacker
description: Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.

title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
description: Bald, pale, tired and cursed with immortality, Count Dracula (Klaus Kinski) visits a plague of rats upon Europe.

title: Fist of Legend
description: A Chinese martial arts student leads his classmates in revolt against Japanese invaders who killed their instructor.

title: Fast Vengeance
description: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

title: Take Back
description: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

title: College
description: To impress his sweetheart (Anne Cornwall), a bookworm (Buster Keaton) goes out for baseball and crew.

title: Prison on Fire
description: Sentenced to two years for accidentally killing a robber, a man (Tony Leung Ka Fai) befriends another prisoner (Chow Yun-Fat) who helps protect him.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

title: Skyline
description: Strange lights over Los Angeles herald the arrival of malevolent aliens who threaten to swallow up humanity.

title: Galaxy of Terror
description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: Heathers
description: Cool Veronica (Winona Ryder) and her quirky new boyfriend (Christian Slater) topple a high-school trio of too-cool Heathers.

title: Deathstalker II
description: Hero Deathstalker (John Terlesky) helps Princess Evie (Monique Gabrielle) reclaim her throne from a sorcerer (John La Zar) and his Princess Evie clone.

title: Among Wolves
description: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.
